summary: Removes the hidden legacy '我的论文库' section from index.html (HTML, renderLibrary, the #library click handler, the .lib-item/.library-* styles, two orphaned translations; loadLibrary becomes refreshStats, which only keeps the top-bar counts current after a save made on the library page). Replaces the old names in comments and the living docs: code comments no longer say knowledge base / knowledge graph (a test pins that for every source file under app/), README and the top of PRODUCT.md and KNOWLEDGE-GRAPH.md carry the current names and what they replaced. Dated records (older HANDOFF entries, evidence, archive, ADRs, change records, task and requirement texts) keep the names of their time.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-layers, after 0700aa9. No behaviour change except that the dead section is gone.

budget_impact.rationale: Deletes unreachable UI code and edits text; no model call, no network, nothing stored.
budget_impact.before: a never-shown library section and old names in comments and docs
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.command: browser preview on a seeded copy
additional_checks.scope: top bar 今日 / 论文库 / 画像, no #view-library, the library page lists 36 rows

open_risks: Removed code was judged unreachable by reading and by the browser (the section was hidden whenever the top bar opened the library page); the Today page and the profile page were not clicked through again.
The top-bar counts after a save are refreshed only while the library page is open (as before); not re-tested in the browser.
Task and requirement texts (harness/tasks.json, requirements.json: 论文整理与阅读捕获, 整理建议...) still use the old words; they are source-of-truth records and were not rewritten.
